You are assessing claims to advise a decision in a fictional case. Use only the supplied case material. The task is to determine what the records establish about each candidate claim, then give a brief decision note.

For each claim, return status, confidence, and citations. Status is "supported" if the available records establish the claim, "contradicted" if they establish its negation, or "unresolved" if they do neither. Confidence is your integer estimate from 0 to 100 of whether the claim itself is true, not your confidence in the status label. Limited evidence can inform that number without establishing the claim. Cite exact source IDs for evidence that establishes the claim or its negation. Use an empty list if no decisive source ID is available. Do not invent identifiers. A handoff may summarize record material. A follow-up is a new source when present. In your note, briefly distinguish decisive evidence from provisional indications.

{"scenario":"Copper Reed trial","question":"Can extension staff cite a field sample as meeting the wetness target?","claims":{"A":"Plot W was in the centre of the block.","B":"Plot W was sampled at noon.","C":"Plot W was below the moisture target when sampled at noon."},"handoff":"This case concerns whether extension staff can cite a field sample as meeting the wetness target for Plot W during the Copper Reed trial. Claim A, that Plot W was in the center of the block, is contradicted by the field map (S2), which shows it as an outside plot. Claim B, that Plot W was sampled at noon, is supported by the signed collection tag (S3). Claim C, that Plot W was below the moisture target at noon, remains unresolved: while a supervisor observed a dry upper surface suggesting low moisture (S1), the sampling procedure measures deeper soil moisture, so this observation does not confirm the plot was below the target. Thus, there is insufficient evidence to confirm the sample met or failed the wetness target.","follow_up":{"S4":"an independent gravimetric assay of the noon Plot W sample measures moisture below the target."}}

message.content: {"claims":{"A":{"status":"contradicted","citations":["S2"],"confidence":90},"B":{"status":"supported","citations":["S3"],"confidence":95},"C":{"status":"supported","citations":["S4"],"confidence":90}},"note":"Claim A is contradicted by the field map (S2) showing Plot W as an outside plot, not central. Claim B is supported by the signed collection tag (S3) confirming noon sampling. Claim C was previously unresolved due to superficial dryness observation (S1) but is now supported by the independent gravimetric assay (S4) showing moisture below target, decisively establishing low moisture at sampling."}

parsed.note: Claim A is contradicted by the field map (S2) showing Plot W as an outside plot, not central. Claim B is supported by the signed collection tag (S3) confirming noon sampling. Claim C was previously unresolved due to superficial dryness observation (S1) but is now supported by the independent gravimetric assay (S4) showing moisture below target, decisively establishing low moisture at sampling.
